agentSource.task: You are a planning agent for the BOS Skill Builder workflow. Read this step's input (task + criteria) and produce a concise implementation plan for a new BrowserOS skill: what it should do, the concrete steps a future agent following it should take, and how to verify it meets the acceptance criteria. Do not save or patch anything yourself — later steps do that.

input.task: Create a skill that reminds the agent to always double-check a file path exists before writing to it.
input.criteria: The skill clearly instructs checking existence before write, and includes a short example.

steps.outputConvention: Plain-text plan in your final message — the next step reads it automatically as upstream context.

agentSource.task: You are a skill-writing agent. Using the upstream PLAN step's output for guidance, write the actual skill content: a short skill name, a one-line description, an optional 'when to use' hint, and the full step-by-step SKILL.md body. Respond with exactly these labeled sections in your final message: 'NAME: ...', 'DESCRIPTION: ...', 'WHEN_TO_USE: ...', 'CONTENT: ...' (CONTENT may be multiple lines).

steps.outputConvention: Plain-text NAME/DESCRIPTION/WHEN_TO_USE/CONTENT sections — the SAVE step reads them as upstream context.

agentSource.task: Read the upstream DRAFT step's NAME/DESCRIPTION/WHEN_TO_USE/CONTENT sections below and call the skill_save tool with them (name, description, whenToUse, content). This is the ONLY tool you may call.

steps.outputConvention: Call skill_save exactly once, then summarize the result in plain text.

agentSource.task: The upstream SAVE step just saved a new skill. Using the original PLAN step's acceptance criteria (also provided as upstream context), review the skill's saved content for correctness and completeness against those criteria. Report PASS or FAIL with specific reasons — do not modify the skill yourself.

Read the upstream TEST step's PASS/FAIL verdict. If it passed, respond with exactly 'NO_CHANGE'. If it failed, respond with a precise 'FIND: <exact text to replace>' / 'REPLACE: <replacement text>' pair describing the smallest edit that would fix the reported problem.

Read the upstream EVALUATE step's output. If it says 'NO_CHANGE', do nothing and respond 'skipped'. Otherwise call the skill_patch tool using the skill named in the upstream DRAFT step's NAME section and the FIND/REPLACE pair from EVALUATE. This is the ONLY tool you may call.

steps.outputConvention: Either 'skipped', or a summary of the patch applied.

agentSource.task: Re-run the same review as the TEST step: using the original PLAN step's acceptance criteria, review the (possibly just-patched) skill named in the DRAFT step's NAME section and report PASS or FAIL with reasons.
